title: strtok
summary: Split text into first token and remainder.

gpu_support.notes: No GPU kernel is registered for this compatibility builtin; GPU-resident inputs are gathered to host memory before evaluation.

fusion.notes: Not eligible for fusion; this builtin materializes host text or logical results.

description: [tok, rem] = strtok(text, delimiters) - Split text into first token and remainder.
behaviors: Split text into first token and remainder.
When multiple outputs are requested, returns both the first token and the remaining text.
Leading delimiters are skipped before token selection; the returned remainder begins at the delimiter after the token.
examples: [tok,rem] = strtok("  alpha,beta", " ,") returns tok = "alpha" and rem = ",beta".
